name: Torwa Pathfinder
label: Quest
description: Torwa Pathfinder: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A hunter by the name of Torwa Pathfinder has requested the help of a druid. He said only we would possess the necessary skills and respect for nature to help him.
There is a road that connects the Un'Goro Crater and the desert of Tanaris. As that road enters the crater, you will find Torwa close by.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have traveled far to meet with me, adventurer, and not a moment too soon.
